system_texts: Budget constraints require price reductions and feature compromises to stay within budget.
There is a problem with a two-euro cost increase.
We don't have any basic options any more.
Speech recognition is expensive and not previously evaluated.
gold_texts: The design cost about EUR 25 at the start of this meeting against a EUR 12.50 production allowance. The team reduced features and the project manager later reported it within budget.
The group initially disagreed about which features and controls to cut; it settled on retaining the LCD, removing speech, simplifying controls and using cheaper casing/power choices.

Cost information arrived after concept/prototype work, forcing substantial rework. Participants said the financial review should have occurred before drawing; the process problem had no agreed preventive fix.

The industrial designer questioned whether mixed positive/negative wording invalidated the mean score. Marketing explained the intended positive criteria and the industrial designer accepted that explanation within the meeting.
